name: HUB Protocol
description: $HUB Protocol — Yield optimizer layer for OTC desk NFTs and RWA Earnings.
manifesto: $HUB is the yield layer for OTC Desk holders. We don't gatekeep alpha — we compound it on-chain, in the open, epoch after epoch. Every desk that activates feeds the pot; every pot feeds the desks that hold it down. No custodians, no black boxes: the treasury, the tokenomics, and the payouts all live on Solana where anyone can verify them. $HUB exists so that holding an OTC Desk means more than holding a picture — it means owning a claim on real, RWA-backed yield, distributed transparently to the people who showed up first. Unhinged by name, disciplined by code.
